refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to retrieve a child from a branch node

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeFetchChild function retrieves the child of object at the specified child_index, leaving the child in its place.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: If object is a branch node, and child_index is in range, SilikoNodeFetchChild returns a pointer to the child. Otherwise, SilikoNodeFetchChild returns NULL. This pointer is still managed by the parent and should not be passed to SilikoNodeDestroy or added as a child to another branch node.
